newsitem.title: UK: Kleinwort ousts Warburg from top spot in survey.
newsitem.headline: Kleinwort ousts Warburg from top spot in survey.

text.p: Kleinwort Benson has ousted SBC Warburg as UK industry's favourite provider of stockbroker research, according to Concensus Research International's 1996 annual broker survey, which was released on Thursday.

The report said SBC Warburg had been knocked off the top spot, after five years of heading the list, which is based on the views of finance directors and corporate treasurers from major UK companies. Warburg was listed number two in the overall list, with Merrill Lynch third, UBS fourth and HSBC James Capel in fifth place.
